extension.summary: Free recipe and cooking videos from iFood.tv (unofficial)
extension.description:
Browse and play iFood.tv's free cooking catalogue: Home, Top Youtubers, Movies & Shows, Dish, Fun With Food, Ingredients, Cuisine, Healthy, Method, Speciality and Taste, with search and My List. Videos are plain MP4 or HLS; no DRM module is needed.
No account or sign-up -- the service has none. iFood.tv runs on Future Today's platform (the same one as Fawesome); this add-on uses its undocumented website API and may need updating when the site changes.
Known gaps: the service is ad-supported and its web player requests ads separately from the video (client-side VMAP). This add-on plays the programme stream only and does not insert those ads. It is US-centric; the catalogue may differ or be unavailable elsewhere.
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Future Today Inc. iFood.tv is a trademark of Future Today Inc.
extension.news: 2026.11.21 - First test build - Browse iFood.tv's recipe sections (dish, cuisine, ingredient, method...), search, and play. - My List (watchlist), search, subtitles where available, and a self-heal when the site ships a new build -- all shared with the Fawesome add-on.
